item.text:
**Public draft**

I committed a reusable template.

The next time I need the same structure, I have a place to start. The template gives me a starting point, and each new use will show me what belongs in the template and what needs to stay flexible.

**Private review note**

The receipt confirms the commit. The draft frames reuse as a future possibility and leaves out the owner’s motivation, intended audience, and any time savings.
